key_variables.outcome_primary: fin22a (Borrowed from a formal bank or similar financial institution; 1 Yes / 2 No / 3 DK / 4 Refused; non-null 102954, yes 10457)
key_variables.exposure_primary: anydigpayment (Made or received a digital payment; 1/0; non-null 102954, yes 57753)
key_variables.exposure_splits: receive_wages / receive_transfers / receive_pensions / receive_agriculture (1 = into an account); merchantpay_dig / pay_utilities (making)
key_variables.controls: account_fin, female, age, educ (1-3), inc_q (1-5), urbanicity, internet_use, emp_in
key_variables.secondary_outcomes: fin20 (applied for a loan using a mobile phone); fin24 (main emergency-money source, 4 = loan from FI/employer/private lender)
key_variables.survey_design: wgt (weight); wpid_random (respondent id); NO psu/strata released; cluster SEs by economy

artifacts.structural_coverage_note: fin22a / anydigpayment / dig_account / borrowed / saved / merchantpay_dig each have exactly 102954 non-null (41136 missing), concentrated in economies administered a reduced questionnaire. Of the 102954 non-missing fin22a rows, 102644 are valid 1/2 responses across 98 module economies; 310 DK/refused rows are excluded. The REVISION 1 primary population is module-administered economies with complete primary covariates, not a developing/emerging-only population.
